1907 — 1979

The Butterfly Job

You have been dropped into seven moments across the twentieth century. Each time, you are a minor figure — a laundress, a newspaper seller, a guard on a corridor. You are not the subject of the history.

You will make a small decision. The kind that barely registers at the time. You will not know, until after you've made it, what was riding on it.

Seven decisions. Some will leave the timeline as you found it. Some won't. At the end, a report.
